Still no production caller of clear() anywhere. harbor_master's charter names this exact condition as its own falsifier, so either the falsifier is wrong or emit must refuse an uncleared crossing.')

(the option he selected carried its own scope, and it is part of the ruling: 'Law 4: the chokepoint refuses a crossing carrying no cleared_by. This is a stone, not an edit — it needs an answer for what actor/boat_owner/method a CC-made crossing has, and MethodRegistry has no production register() call, so every crossing would re-run a proof. Also needs a NAMED bootstrap exemption (the gate must be crossed into existence). I'd cast it as a ticket, not build it now.')
